sites.name: Coderwall
sites.notes: Sign in then visit [https://coderwall.com/delete_account](https://coderwall.com/delete_account)

sites.name: CodeSignal
sites.notes: Sign in, visit the provided link and press delete profile

sites.name: Codetasty
sites.notes: Log in, press the url, press 'Deactivate Account' which will disable your account for some time and then permanently delete

sites.name: Codewars
sites.notes: Go to your 'Account Settings' and scroll to the bottom to find the 'Delete Account' section

sites.name: Codingame
sites.notes: Go to your 'Settings' and scroll to the bottom to find the 'Danger Zone' section. However, the source code one has published will be kept in the system with a GPLv3 license.

sites.name: CoffeeCup
sites.notes: You need to contact them via email. They usually reply quickly.

sites.name: Cohost
sites.notes: Click settings on the left, scroll to the bottom of the page, confirm your email address and password, and wait for 3 days. Accounts can be deleted faster than the default 3 days by emailing Cohost.

sites.name: Coin
sites.notes: Contact them via ticketing system and ask for account to be deleted

sites.name: Coinbase
sites.notes: Sign in then visit [their website](https://www.coinbase.com/settings/privacy-rights) and request the deletion of all of your data. You will then be directed to [their account activity page](https://www.coinbase.com/settings/account_activity) where you must close your account after withdrawing all funds.

sites.name: CoinBR/Stratum
sites.notes: Contact the customer support via email and request the deletion of your account. In order for them to identify your account, make the request through the same email address that you have used to create your CoinBR/Stratum account.

sites.name: CoinEx
sites.notes: Sign in then visit [your security settings](https://www.coinex.com/en/my/info/security), scroll down to Advanced Settings and click Delete next to Account Management.

sites.name: CoinGecko
sites.notes: You can delete your CoinGecko account directly from the website by clicking the 'Profile' icon ⮕ 'Login' and 'Security'. At the 'Login and Security' page, please click on 'Delete my account' to proceed with account deletion

sites.name: CoinMarketCap
sites.notes: CoinMarketCap provides a button to automatically request account deletion. The account deletion process is said to take up to 21 days.

sites.name: CoinPayments
sites.notes: According to their own policy, accounts can never be deleted.

sites.name: CoinSpot
sites.notes: Once you have removed all wallet balances, you need to create a ticket.

sites.name: Cointree
sites.notes: Complete the form and wait for their support to delete the account.

sites.name: Collegeboard
sites.notes: You can't delete your College Board account, but you can close it by calling their customer service at 866-315-6068

sites.name: Comment ça marche
sites.notes: Your messages will remain on the forums.

sites.name: Compiled
sites.notes: Enter your user settings and select "Delete Account," and "Delete" when prompted again. This is irreversible.

sites.name: Computeruniverse
sites.notes: You need to email them to request deletion of your data.

sites.name: Contabo
sites.notes: The account will be deleted automatically shortly after the last product on the account itself is canceled.

sites.name: Conte.it
sites.notes: Fill out the form to request cancellation from Conte.it's insurance services.

sites.name: Cook It
sites.notes: It is only possible to permanently disable the automatic subscription fee. Doing so will also set your stars back to 0.

sites.name: Coolors
sites.notes: Use the link provided to request account deletion. Enter your password, then you get an e-mail with a code. Enter this code in the next input field. If you created the account with a 'Social Login' you need to set a password first.

sites.name: Coolshop.dk
sites.notes: Account deletion can be requested from within ones account settings. It takes them up to 24 hours to process the request.

sites.name: Copyleaks
sites.notes: Account ⮕ Security ⮕ Delete Account (On the bottom of the page). If you wish to delete all data, use [this page](https://id.copyleaks.com/security/delete-internal-data).

sites.name: Copyrighted
sites.notes: Enter your current password to confirm deletion.

sites.name: Corellium
sites.notes: Click the Delete Account button.

sites.name: Cors Proxy
sites.notes: Just go to your profile and click 'Delete Account', then type 'Delete account' in the box provided.

sites.name: CoSpaces
sites.notes: Go to the linked page and scroll down to the bottom of page. From there, click the 'Delete' button next to the 'Delete account' section.

sites.name: Coub
sites.notes: Visit the linked page. From the left column, select your username. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click "Delete Account".

sites.name: Couchsurfing
sites.notes: Go the [Account & Settings](https://www.couchsurfing.com/preferences/account) page. Click Deactivate My Account in the bottom right corner. Enter your email and click Delete. Check your email and click the button to complete deletion.

sites.name: Couponut
sites.notes: Log in then visit the linked page, click on Security tab, scroll to the bottom of the page and click "Delete Account".

sites.name: Coursera
sites.notes: Delete account button is at the bottom of the account settings page.

sites.name: Covoitéo par Karos
sites.notes: To delete your account, go at the bottom of the "Help" category, and click on "Delete my account".

sites.name: Cracker Barrel
sites.notes: Visit their Privacy Policy website ⮕ Section E, number 9, PRIVACY PORTAL link ⮕ Click URL ⮕ Fill out form (includes filling out personal info) ⮕ Verify your email ⮕ Wait for a response

sites.name: Craft
sites.notes: Settings ⮕ Account Settings ⮕ Scroll down till Danger Zone ⮕ Delete Account ⮕ Confirm

sites.name: Craigslist
sites.notes: Send an email to abuse@craigslist.org and request deletion.

sites.name: CrashPlan
sites.notes: Start a live chat session and a representative will delete your account.

sites.name: Creativebug
sites.notes: Fill out the form with the name and email of the account you wish to have deleted. Ensure 'Request Topic' is set to 'Delete Me' and they will send email confirmation when someone has deleted the account.

sites.name: Credit Karma
sites.notes: Membership can be canceled either online or by mail. Once you cancel, you will no longer have access to your Credit Karma account history and you won’t be able to create a new account for six months.

sites.name: CreditExpert
sites.notes: You can cancel by email but only if your membership includes insurance. Otherwise, an email cancellation will be ignored. You have to call 0800 561 0083 to cancel your account. This is the only way. More info [here](http://experian.metafaq.com/help/CreditExpertBRS/Cancel_and_duration/CancelBRS)

sites.name: Credly
sites.notes: On the profile settings page, scroll down and click 'Delete my Profile'.

sites.name: Cronometer
sites.notes: Login ⮕ More ⮕ Account ⮕ Delete Account

sites.name: Crowdcast.io
sites.notes: You can pause your account for $10/mo or cancel your account.

sites.name: Crowdfinder
sites.notes: Request requires sending a proof of identity

sites.name: Crowdfire
sites.notes: Deleted after 48 hours of request

sites.name: Crowdin
sites.notes: Login to your account. Click on 'Settings', then 'Delete Account' (at the bottom). Choose one of the options why you want to delete your account and click 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: Crowdsorsa
sites.notes: As of now there's not a simple way to delete your account. You have to contact their team, your account will be quickly deleted upon request.

sites.name: CryEngine
sites.notes: Go to your dashboard, click 'Delete your account' and confirm.

sites.name: Crypton.sh
sites.notes: Scroll down the page, click at "Delete My Account", type your password and confirm your action by clicking "Delete Account".

sites.name: CryptoPanic
sites.notes: Click on 'Yes, send confirmation email', and you should receive an email to delete your account.

sites.name: CryptoVoucher
sites.notes: Just click the close account button in the account settings

sites.name: CryptPad
sites.notes: Scroll down to the red 'Delete your account' button and then select 'OK (enter)'

sites.name: Crytek
sites.notes: You can delete your account by navigating to the profile settings or e-mailing them

sites.name: CTFLearn
sites.notes: There is no guaranteed way to delete your account, as the website does not offer a button or a form. The provided email addresses do not work probably due to server misconfigurations. The only potential option is to contact an admin on their Discord, but success is not guaranteed.

sites.name: cTrader
sites.notes: You need to contact customer support and they will ask for very sensitive information such as your passport number.

sites.name: Cubeast
sites.notes: Select "Remove Account," confirm your email, then select "DELETE MY ACCOUNT."

sites.name: CubieCloud
sites.notes: Send an email asking to delete your account, providing your private id and other evidence.

sites.name: Culma
sites.notes: Sign in, then confirm 'Delete account'. A paid plan must be canceled and have ended first. The app used on one device without sync has no account to delete.

sites.name: Cults3d
sites.notes: Go to your profile, Settings, Account then all the way down 'Destroy my Cults account completely'

sites.name: Cultura
sites.notes: Send a request to personal data rights service. They will delete your account without contacting you to confirm.

sites.name: Curriculum
sites.notes: There's no way to delete an account. The maximum that can be done is to hide the curriculum.

sites.name: CurseForge
sites.notes: Send a support ticket from the email associated with your account and include the following information: your account username; a screenshot of you logged in to account settings / authors dashboard.

sites.name: Cursor
sites.notes: Follow the link. Expand the "Advanced" section. Click "Delete Account".

sites.name: Curve
sites.notes: They cannot delete your account immediately as they are obliged by the Money Laundering Regulations 2017 to keep your data for 5 years after you stop using Curve.

sites.name: Cutout
sites.notes: Go to My Dashboard, then Account Settings to delete your account.

sites.name: CV online
sites.notes: Request account removal by sending an email to them from the same email address appearing on your CVs.

sites.name: CVS Pharmacy
sites.notes: They allow account deletions under the CCPA, but only for California residents. However, the way they check your location is simply a ZIP code of your choosing. You can input any California ZIP (ex. 94102) and they will allow you to delete your account. Visit the linked page, and select 'CA residents: request or delete personal information.' Enter any California ZIP code, then click 'Delete my info and account', and finally 'Yes, delete my info and account'.

sites.name: Cybrary
sites.notes: Go to "Delete Your Account ⮕ Delete Account".

sites.name: CZC
sites.notes: You have to fill out a form. (BUT IT'S ONLY IN CZECH)

sites.name: DaFONT
sites.notes: Send a private message to [Rodolphe](http://www.dafont.com/fr/profile.php?user=1).

sites.name: DagsHub
sites.notes: You first need to delete/transfer all your repositories. After that you can visit the linked page and delete your account.

sites.name: Dailymotion
sites.notes: Type your password and confirm your action by clicking "Delete account".

sites.name: Dan Murphy's
sites.notes: You can delete your account either using the mobile app and accessing 'Account' at the bottom right, or by using the live chat in a website browser.

sites.name: danwin1210.me
sites.notes: You can either disable or remove your account. After removal, username is free to be taken again.

sites.name: Darty
sites.notes: You need to send an account deletion request.

sites.name: Dashlane
sites.notes: After entering the email address and selecting a reason for deletion, you will receive a security code by email. Enter the security code. After that, the account will be irretrievably deleted.

sites.name: data.gouv.fr
sites.notes: On your profile page, click on the arrow next to the "Edit" button, in the top right of your screen, then on "Delete my profile"

sites.name: DataCamp
sites.notes: Click the red 'delete account' button at the bottom.

sites.name: DataQuest
sites.notes: Click the red 'delete account' button

sites.name: Dazn
sites.notes: You need to log in, open the chat and request account deletion.

sites.name: Deadspin
sites.notes: Fill out the form using the email address of your account and click on the verification link that is sent.

sites.name: Decathlon
sites.notes: On your account page, go to "Privacy and Security" and "Delete my account" then scroll down to click on "Delete my account". You will be asked to confirm through SMS or Email

sites.name: Decathlon India
sites.notes: Send them a deletion request from the linked contact form and remember to mention your decathlon.in registered email there. After some hours of submitting the request their support representative will email you asking for your confirmation to have your decathlon account permanently deleted. Alternatively, you can email them.

sites.name: DeepSeek
sites.notes: Using a PC, go to "My Profile" in the lower-left hand corner, then click "Settings". A pop-up window appears. Click on the "Profile" tab and then click on the red "Delete" button. If using mobile, tap the burger menu in the upper-left hand corner, then tap your username in the lower-left. After that, tap the last option in red, "Delete account".

sites.name: Deezer
sites.notes: If you signed up via Google/Facebook setup a Deezer password at [https://www.deezer.com/password/reset](https://www.deezer.com/password/reset) and click the confirmation link you'll get via mail. If you have your Deezer password, open your account settings. Click 'Delete my Account' at the bottom of the page. Enter your Deezer password and confirm the deletion in the confirmation mail.

sites.name: Deliveroo
sites.notes: At the bottom of the account page is the option to permanently deactivate your account. It is unclear if your data will be retained after this so you may wish to contact dpo@deliveroo.com to exercise your right to erasure under UK GDPR.

sites.name: Delivery Code
sites.notes: Go to My Account and select Edit Profile and then Delete Account. A confirmation e-mail will be sent to the address on file with a link you must visit.

sites.name: Dell
sites.notes: Submitting a privacy request allows you to request permanent deletion of your personal information, instead of simply deactivating your account, the default option in account settings.

sites.name: Delta Airlines (SkyMiles)
sites.notes: You can not delete your account on the site. You must use the linked form. Then select SkyMiles ⮕ Update SkyMiles Account and request them to close your account.

sites.name: DelugeRPG
sites.notes: There is no way to delete an account. Inactive accounts are deleted automatically after 15 months.

sites.name: Demiplane
sites.notes: You must submit a support ticket to request account closure.

sites.name: Depop
sites.notes: Select 'I want to delete my account' in the support request page.

sites.name: Depositphotos
sites.notes: Enter live chat in the other department and request cancellation of your account or if it is not available use the contact form.

sites.name: Desmos
sites.notes: Click on your name in the top right, click 'Account Settings', click 'Delete your Desmos account?' in the bottom right of the popup, then click 'Send Delete Account Email'. Click the big red button in the email and your account will be deleted in 30 days.

sites.name: Deutsche Bahn / DB
sites.notes: In the "Manage customer account" section, go to "Personal details" and then select the "Delete account" option at the bottom. Now follow the instructions to delete your customer account.

sites.name: Deutsche Post
sites.notes: Fill out the form to request erasure.

sites.name: DEV
sites.notes: Go to your 'Settings'. On the left select 'Account'. Click 'Delete Account', and follow the instructions sent via email to confirm.

sites.name: DeviantArt
sites.notes: All your data is erased immediately, except comments which will remain. Accounts can be reactivated within 30 days. After that, Accounts can't be reactivated.

sites.name: DevITjobs
sites.notes: Click on the 'Log in here' button. After logging in, go to 'Account', then 'Delete Account'. You will be redirected to write to the support email. Account gets deleted within 48 hours.

sites.name: Devographics (State of JS)
sites.notes: According to their help page, you need to send an e-mail to them to request the deletion. However, they seemingly never respond.

sites.name: DFCG
sites.notes: Contact support via email to request your account to be deleted.

sites.name: DHL
sites.notes: Under 'Kundenkonto', click on 'Konto löschen'.

sites.name: Dia
sites.notes: Open the first tab of the settings inside the app, click the "..." button in the bottom right corner, select "Delete Account...", then confirm deletion.

sites.name: DialLink
sites.notes: Under 'Settings' go to 'Company' and click on 'Delete account'.

sites.name: diasp.eu (Diaspora)
sites.notes: Click close my account and confirm with your password.

sites.name: Dice
sites.notes: Go to your 'Settings'. Scroll to the bottom to find the 'Delete Account' section.

sites.name: DiceCloud
sites.notes: There are no settings on the website to delete your account and the contact form is never answered.

sites.name: dict.cc
sites.notes: Account data will be deleted; the user name will be blocked to prevent reuse.

sites.name: Dictionary.com
sites.notes: Account data will be deleted along with all the saved data and words. You fill find the detele button at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: Didsoft
sites.notes: Create a ticket on the website, or email them.

sites.name: Digg
sites.notes: Go to "Settings ⮕ Delete my account".

sites.name: Digio
sites.notes: There is no delete button and talking to the customer support gets you nowhere, they only understand you want to cancel the bank account or the credit card, but not remove the login information.

sites.name: DigitalOcean
sites.notes: Click in the checkbox "Purge all of my account data" and confirm your action by clicking "Deactivate Account".

sites.name: Diigo
sites.notes: Scroll down the page, click at "I'd like to delete my account.", type your password and confirm your action by clicking "Confirm Delete".

sites.name: Discord
sites.notes: While account deletion will go through, it will NOT delete your messages, which you must do manually, or by following this tutorial to ask for deletion of your messages, which requires that you first request your data package: [discorch.org](https://discorch.org). Your account must stay active while awaiting Discord's response. NOTE: Discord will only delete any of your messages in servers and group DMs that you are not a member of; 1-1 DMs must be manually deleted, or automated through same the link above. If you are an owner of any servers, you must either [delete it](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/213595197), or [transfer ownership](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/216273938) before you are able to delete your account.

sites.name: Disney+
sites.notes: Deletable through account management. This will not delete your MyDisney account, see the relevant entry for it.

sites.name: Displate
sites.notes: Click the "Deactivate account" button.

sites.name: Disroot
sites.notes: Go to the home page, click the user icon then press 'Delete my Account', nobody will be able to use the same username after deletion.

sites.name: distill.io
sites.notes: Click the 'Close Account' button to delete your account.

sites.name: Divize
sites.notes: Click on "Delete" and confirm by clicking on "Yes, Delete it!".

sites.name: DLH
sites.notes: Complete the captcha and press the button to request account deletion. An email will be sent to you to confirm such action.

sites.name: DLive
sites.notes: In settings scroll to the bottom, click the delete account button and enter your password. Your account will be deleted in 30 days.

sites.name: Do IT
sites.notes: E-mailing them is a deadend even after waiting for several weeks.

sites.name: DocHub
sites.notes: Log in, under "Account" click "Delete my Account".

sites.name: Docker
sites.notes: Log in, under account settings find and use "Deactivate Account".

sites.name: Doctolib
sites.notes: Scroll down to the bottom of the page and click on 'Delete my account'.

sites.name: DocuSign
sites.notes: Follow the instructions at the linked support page; directions vary depending on account type and privileges.

sites.name: Doksure
sites.notes: GDPR compliant. Go to Settings ⮕ Account ⮕ Delete Account.

sites.name: Dolphin Anty
sites.notes: You have to send a message in their support chat, email them after they respond, then respond to them after you email, and the account is deleted.

sites.name: DonationAlerts
sites.notes: Press "Delete account" under the "Account removal". Your account will be deleted within a month.

sites.name: Doodle
sites.notes: In your Doodle account select 'Delete Doodle account' at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: DoorDash
sites.notes: You will need the phone tied to your account to receive the 2FA code.

sites.name: Douyin
sites.notes: You can log out of your account at 'Me'⮕'≡'⮕'Settings'⮕'Account and Security'⮕'Cancel Account'. However, your account has to meet the conditions linked.

sites.name: DOWN
sites.notes: You can delete it in the settings page

sites.name: Dr. Martens
sites.notes: Fill out relevant information, select "delete" under "What type of request..." and follow the verification link sent to your email after submitting.

sites.name: Drawabox
sites.notes: Send an email from the address associated with the account you'd like to delete.

sites.name: Drawboard PDF
sites.notes: Click on your profile picture in the top right, click "Permanently delete account", then just enter your email to confirm.

sites.name: Draxlr
sites.notes: Contact customer support to request account deletion. They should respond and will delete any personal information, database credentials and result caches that you have provided along with your account within 4 working days.

sites.name: Dreamstime
sites.notes: Click on the "Delete account" link towards the bottom of the page and then confirm your action in the opened pop-up. Accounts can be deleted only if you have no activity registered (uploads, downloads, comments,blogs etc).

sites.name: Dreamwidth
sites.notes: Changing your account status to Deleted will immediately hide your profile and journal from other users, but your account will not be removed for 30 days.

sites.name: DriveThruRPG
sites.notes: Submit a request asking for the deletion of your account providing your username

sites.name: Drivvo
sites.notes: On the app, open the 'Menu' ⮕ 'My Account' ⮕ tap the three dots on the upper right corner, click 'Delete Account' and confirm.

sites.name: Drizly
sites.notes: Fill out the form and/or email them through their contact page: https://drizly.com/contact-us. They will email you promptly to let you know that your account has been deleted.

sites.name: Dronebase
sites.notes: Contact support to find out if you can delete your account.

sites.name: Drop (Massdrop)
sites.notes: Log into your Drop account and submit a Support ticket on drop.com/support. Under Reason for Contacting Support, select Account inquiries.

sites.name: Droplr
sites.notes: Click at "Delete Account", type your email address and confirm your action by clicking "Delete".

sites.name: Dropmark
sites.notes: Personal accounts can be deleted from the "Danger Zone" section at the bottom of your [Account page](https://app.dropmark.com/account). Note: Before deleting your personal account, you must first [transfer ownership](https://support.dropmark.com/article/53-transferring-collection-ownership) or [delete all collections](https://support.dropmark.com/article/20-deleting-a-collection) owned by your account.

sites.name: DTF
sites.notes: Log into your account. Click on your profile picture in the top right corner (bottom right on mobile), then on "Настройки". Select "Основные". There click on the blue "удалить свой аккаунт" link at the bottom. Type your deletion reason and press the red "Удалить" button, then the red "Подтвердить" button.

sites.name: Duet Night Abyss
sites.notes: Requires contacting player support, with the request of deleting the account.

sites.name: Dune
sites.notes: Click Delete account and type ‘DELETE’ to confirm

sites.name: Dunkindonuts
sites.notes: Click Personal Information, Click Delete My Account, Confirm ‘Yes, I want to proceed’, Reason for deleting your account, Choose ‘Other’, Type: I want to delete all of my private information. Then check both boxes if you agree. First box asks: Check here if you would like Dunkin’ Donuts to delete all of the personal information we have collected from you (subject to permitted exceptions). Second box: I understand that by deleting my information, I will no longer be able to use my DD Perks Account and will forfeit any accrued Perks Rewards. Then click Next, Then confirm by clicking ‘Delete My Account’.  Then you will get a confirmation page that says: Thank you for your request, this confirms that your account has been deleted! You then get an email that says it can take 48 hours to update.

sites.name: Duo
sites.notes: Delete all applications, users and other administrators in the Admin Panel according to the [support article](https://help.duo.com/s/article/2162), then contact support via email.

sites.name: Duolicious
sites.notes: Log into your account. Go to the "Profile" tab. Scroll down and press "Delete My Account". Type "delete" then press "Done".

sites.name: Duolingo
sites.notes: Scroll down and click "ERASE PERSONAL DATA". You will receive an e-mail in which you have to click the link after "Delete my data link:". This confirms the erasure of your personal data and account. On Android, just tap your profile then delete account and confirm after 4 seconds

sites.name: Duotrope
sites.notes: You must submit a support ticket to request account deletion.

sites.name: Dwell
sites.notes: It’s not possible to delete an account, you can either remove or replace your contact information with bogus details.

sites.name: Dwolla
sites.notes: Dwolla accounts cannot be deleted, only disabled. To request deactivation of your account, contact support via email.

sites.name: Dynadot
sites.notes: Click the red "Deactivate" button under "Advanced Settings" in "Account Settings". Although easy to do, it may take several years for them to actually delete your account.

sites.name: e621
sites.notes: Even though there is a delete option, the site states it will only change your account to a generic name and lock it. Your contributions (submissions, comments, etc) will remain.

sites.name: EA Games / Origin / Electronic Arts
sites.notes: Follow the link and open a support ticket at the section "Delete my account and related information". They might close your ticket or mark it as solved; be patient, as the [wait time might take over a month](https://www.reddit.com/r/electronicarts/comments/1ntq2nt/comment/nhbzhlc). Make sure you do not log in during this time. You can also contact them via online chat, but the wait time might be longer than 40 minutes; they might also disconnect you. If any of those didn't do the job, send the email to the Data Protection Officer, as they have to comply with laws.

sites.name: EasyEDA
sites.notes: Log into easyeda.com first, then click on the provided URL. Type 'DELETE' into the input box and click the Delete button.

sites.name: easyfundraising
sites.notes: Click on 'account' on the top right, then click 'Manage your data'. Click 'Learn more' under 'Delete your account and information' section. You will be prompted to enter your password.

sites.name: easyJet
sites.notes: You have to fill out the Data protection request form on their website, providing your identification.

sites.name: EatStreet
sites.notes: Though you can deactivate your account under "My Account", in order to permanently delete your account, you must contact support and request deletion at: customer.service@eatstreet.com.

sites.name: EBANX
sites.notes: Customer support says that EBANX accounts can't be deleted, as the information about user transactions (e.g: payments) may be necessary in the future for, according to them, "legal obligations and legitimate interests".

sites.name: eBay
sites.notes: Hover over name on top left, click 'Account settings', click 'Close account' under the Account preferences column, then scroll down and click 'Close account and delete my data'. Select why you are leaving from drop down and continue. Click on checkmark and then click the left button to close your account. If you want an extra safety measure, replace all of your personal info with fake info before closing the account.

sites.name: eBonus
sites.notes: After submitting a contact form, they will ask for confirmation using email. After confirmation, account deletion takes 30 days.

sites.name: Economist
sites.notes: There are two ways to contact this website, such as calling a phone number that is based on where you reside, or use the live chat.

sites.name: Ecosia
sites.notes: To delete your account, click on your profile picture in the top right and then on Your Profile. After that, you click on the settings in the top right again and then at the click at the bottom on Delete Account. Now you have to sign in again to delete your account and your finished.

sites.name: Ecwid
sites.notes: Click 'Close Account' in profile settings and then click 'Yes'.

sites.name: Ed2Go
sites.notes: There is no outright way to delete your account. You need to submit a request with your relevant details.

sites.name: Edabit
sites.notes: On the website, click on your avatar, click on Settings, click Account, and hit the 'Delete Account' button

sites.name: Edizioni Simone
sites.notes: Contact support via email and request your account to be deleted.

sites.name: Edpuzzle
sites.notes: Scroll the bottom of the linked page and click 'Delete account'. Student accounts can only be deleted by request of a school teacher or administrator, or after 18 months of account inactivity. See their support article for more information: https://support.edpuzzle.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407364156557-How-Do-I-Delete-My-Account-

sites.name: Edraw Software
sites.notes: You need to contact Edraw Software support through their support center.

sites.name: eDreams
sites.notes: Click on "I want to delete My Account".

sites.name: Educaplay

sites.notes: While Intellius will not delete your account login, you can request to have your records removed. Send an email to Intelius support to request deletion. A support representative will eventually respond with instructions on how to delete your account. Follow these directions CAREFULLY, as they describe a process that is VERY similar to a Public Records Opt Out, which does not necessarily involve data deletion. Note: The request process may include selecting your public records from a list. If your records do not appear, scroll to the bottom of the list and click the link to "continue with your CCPA request". Click the link in the resulting email confirmation. Within 24 hours, your records should no longer appear on Intelius, barring extenuating circumstances. To permanently close your account, the best option is to change and forget your login credentials.

sites.name: mailbox.org
sites.notes: Account Settings ⮕ Delete Account.

sites.name: MailChimp
sites.notes: Account Settings ⮕ Account Settings Drop-down ⮕ Close my account ⮕ Type DELETE and press Delete Account button.

sites.name: Mailfence
sites.notes: Go to 'Settings'⮕'General'⮕'Delete Account'.

sites.name: Mailspring
sites.notes: Sign in ⮕ Click the 'Delete your Mailspring ID' button ⮕ Confirm

sites.name: Major Phones
sites.notes: Sign in ⮕ Profile ⮕ Delete Account ⮕ Confirm with your password (or Google sign-in). If two-factor authentication is enabled, disable it first.

sites.name: MakeMyTrip
sites.notes: App ⮕ Menu ⮕ Account ⮕ Settings ⮕ Delete.

sites.name: MakerBot
sites.notes: Click 'DELETE ACCOUNT' at the bottom of the 'Account Settings' page, then click 'DELETE'. This will also delete your Thingiverse account.

sites.name: MakerWorld
sites.notes: In your account settings, click 'Delete Account' at the bottom of the 'Security and Privacy' page, then click 'DELETE'. You will have to re enter your credentials. This will also delete your Bambu Lab account since they are the same one.

sites.name: MangaDex
sites.notes: Automatic account deletion has been "Temporarily Unavailable" since about 2023, you must send an email to the support email address from your registered email and request they delete your account. See [this reddit comment](https://www.reddit.com/r/mangadex/comments/167mfkg/comment/jyqkvk5/?context=3) for the reasons why.

sites.name: Mangaupdates
sites.notes: Contact lambchopsil through PM or email.

sites.name: Mangools
sites.notes: On 'Delete account' section, click the red 'Understand, delete my account'

sites.name: Mapbox
sites.notes: Enter Password ⮕ Scroll to bottom ⮕ Click 'Delete Account'

sites.name: MapMyFitness
sites.notes: This will also delete the profiles for MapMyRun, MapMyWalk, and/or MapMyFitness that are associated with the same email

sites.name: MapMyRun
sites.notes: This will also delete the profiles for MapMyRun, MapMyWalk, and/or MapMyFitness that are associated with the same email

sites.name: MapMyWalk
sites.notes: This will also delete the profiles for MapMyRun, MapMyWalk, and/or MapMyFitness that are associated with the same email

sites.name: Mapstr
sites.notes: Log in to your account in the app, then got to the "Profile" tab and open settings. After that, find the "Data Management" section and click "Delete my account".

sites.name: MarineTraffic
sites.notes: My account ⮕ Delete account (in the bottom) ⮕ Select a reason to quit ⮕ submit

sites.name: Markdown Converter
sites.notes: Go to the linked page and click close button

sites.name: Marktplaats
sites.notes: Log in to Marktplaats. Go to the linked URL or in Marktplaats click on your name at the top right, choose 'Mijn Profiel' and go to your contact information. On this page, click 'Account verwijderen' at the bottom. Indicate why you want to delete your account and click 'Bevestigen'. Your account will be deleted and you will receive a confirmation email.

sites.name: Marq
sites.notes: Account can be deleted from the account settings. If you have an active subscription, then this needs to be cancelled first.

sites.name: Marvel
sites.notes: Log into your account ⮕ My Account ⮕ click on Delete Account at the bottom of page.

sites.name: Masiro
sites.notes: There is no delete button or contact email.

sites.name: MasterClass
sites.notes: It's not possible to delete your account, but you can send a request to delete your personal data by making a Privacy Request.

sites.name: Mastodon.social
sites.notes: Login ⮕ Account Settings ⮕ Security ⮕ Delete Account

sites.name: Match
sites.notes: Only possible within the mobile app, otherwise can only be done via [contacting support](https://help.match.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

sites.name: MatGoat
sites.notes: Sign in ⮕ Go to your Account ⮕ "Delete My Account". You'll receive an email once it's completed.

sites.name: Mathpix
sites.notes: Use the link to navigate to your account settings page. Log in with your email and password then click 'Delete your account'. You will be asked to confirm with your email and a simple captcha. Your email will be blacklisted from creating new accounts.

sites.name: Mathway
sites.notes: Use the link to navigate to your account settings page. Click account, type your password and click delete.

sites.name: Mathworks
sites.notes: Follow the link and use the form to request the deletion of your personal data. Subsequent identity verification may be required. The deletion process should complete within 30 days.

sites.name: Matrix
sites.notes: Exact placement of option depends on client. In L-ement and its forks: at the very bottom of Settings ⮕ General.

sites.name: Maxdome
sites.notes: Contact support via the live chat and request the deletion of your account. This is also possible via the [contact form](https://faq.maxdome.de/kontakt), though it could take longer.

sites.name: Maxforlive
sites.notes: The Maxforlive website is affiliated with Cycling74 headquarters whose customer service you must contact Cycling 74 to delete the account, providing your email address, a screenshot of your associated account, and a reason.

sites.name: MaxMind
sites.notes: You must stop all services and cease downloading any databases before contacting support. State that you wish to delete your account and use your registered email on the contact form.

sites.name: McAfee
sites.notes: You must call McAfee customer support and unsubscribe, which cancels your account. Be sure to have your state ID or driver's license available, as you will be asked questions to verify your identity.

sites.name: McDonald's
sites.notes: In the app, go to 'More', 'Profile', 'Delete account' and confirm.

sites.name: McVIP
sites.notes: Click on 'Edit profile', scroll down to 'You want to delete your profile?', type in your password, click on 'Delete' and then 'Yes, delete it'.

sites.name: Mealpal
sites.notes: You can only delete your account by emailing them.

sites.name: Medal
sites.notes: Scroll down to the bottom of the linked page and click on 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: MediaFire
sites.notes: Scroll to the bottom of the page and click 'Delete my Account', make sure you're logged in and follow the steps.

sites.name: Mediapart
sites.notes: No information is clearly provided how to delete account. You have to send an email to explicitly ask for deletion of every information related to your account otherwise they will only disable it.

sites.name: MeetFrank
sites.notes: Send the team/company/email of the account you want to delete. No verification (not even from the same sender e-mail) required.

sites.name: Meetup
sites.notes: Permenant deletion may be requested via a web form.

sites.name: MEGA
sites.notes: In the bottom right corner of the linked page, click 'Delete account'. Click the confirmation link sent to your email, then select a reason why you want to leave MEGA.

sites.name: Megaknihy
sites.notes: You must call their phone (as of writing +420 222 703 143) and request deletion. They ignored my e-mail.

sites.name: Melodics
sites.notes: It might be possible to delete your account via the contact form, but the support team is known to be unresponsive.

sites.name: MelonCube
sites.notes: Open a ticket outlining your wish for deletion and they will promptly act on it.

sites.name: MemeFast.app
sites.notes: Log in to the mobile app, click on options, then your username at the bottom navigation, select 'Delete Account' under 'Account Management'.

sites.name: Memrise
sites.notes: A 'Delete my account' button is available from your account settings page.

sites.name: Mendeley
sites.notes: Get to Mendeley and request for account to be closed at the privacy settings. Then contact Elsevier support asking for a deletion there too.

sites.name: Mercado Libre Argentina
sites.notes:
To cancel/delete your account, access the account deletion link specified above and log in to your account. In the options, select a reason why you want to cancel your account, click in the checkbox "Estoy de acuerdo", and confirm your action by clinking "Aceptar".

**Warning:** You may cancel your account only if there is no limitation, partial and/or total blockage applied to it. You will also be unable to cancel your account if you have outstanding payments and/or purchases. Mercado Libre and Mercado Pago are services associated with the same type of account. If you choose to delete your Mercado Libre account, your Mercado Pago account will be deleted too.
