sites.notes: You can request the deletion of your account via the assistance form.

sites.name: Meshy.ai
sites.notes: The delete button is at the bottom of the page, after clicking it you need to enter your email to confirm.

sites.name: Meta Account
sites.notes: Select "Delete account" and tap Continue three times, enter your password and press "Delete account". Your account will be deleted in 30 days and the deletion process may take up to 90 days.

sites.name: Metacritic
sites.notes: You need to submit a request for account deletion. But for that, you need to create a fandom account.

sites.name: MetLife
sites.notes: They claim nothing can be deleted.

sites.name: Metrofun
sites.notes: On the website: in the customer service page, scroll past the FAQ, and fill the form titled "Still need help?", or contact them via WhatsApp or phone. In the app: open side menu, click on support, and follow the exact steps of the website instructions.

sites.name: Metropolis
sites.notes: Account Settings ⮕ Terms and Privacy ⮕ Delete Account

sites.name: MEXC
sites.notes: To delete your account, send an e-Mail to their Data Protection team. Include in the e-Mail your MEXC user ID (UID; seen in the user pop-up at the top right of the page), the reason for deletion, and a photo of yourself holding your ID card and a handwritten piece of paper with the following information: "Today is (put date here). I request the deletion of my MEXC account with UID (put your UID here). I confirm and accept to waive all assets contained in this account. (sign here)"

sites.name: Mibbit
sites.notes: Sign in and use the 'Account' link at the top right. At the bottom of the page is a link to delete your account.

sites.name: Michaels
sites.notes: Use the deletion link. Select 'Data Deletion' and enter your Account information.

sites.name: Microsoft Account
sites.notes: Use the deletion link. Your account will be deleted after 30/60 days (depending on your settings there).

sites.name: Midjourney
sites.notes: Go to your account page, scroll down to the 'How can I delete my account?' section in the FAQ and click on the 'Click here' button.

sites.name: Mikan Project
sites.notes: There is no delete button nor do they ever reply by e-mail.

sites.name: Milanote
sites.notes: Enter your email, click on "Yes, delete my account", then enter your password and click on "Continue".

sites.name: Mimo
sites.notes: Click on 'Delete my account' then 'Delete Account' to delete your account.

sites.name: MindMeister
sites.notes: You have to cancel your plan first

sites.name: Mine
sites.notes: Click 'Delete your Mine Account' at the bottom of the page, acknowledge that you wish to proceed and click 'Delete my Account'

sites.name: Minecraft
sites.notes: On the linked page, chose the dropdown boxes that apply. Preferably use the email address that the account is associated with. You will be required to supply the transaction ID for the purchase of the account, or any other valid proof-of-purchase. If you have migrated to a Microsoft account, visit [this page](https://support.xbox.com/contact-us), sign in, and start a session with the virtual agent. Specify that your minecraft profile is linked to your microsoft account, and that you wish for it to be deleted. Alternatively, if you do not use your Microsoft account for anything else, you can [close your account](https://account.live.com/closeaccount.aspx) entirely.

sites.name: Minecraft Tools
sites.notes: The only way to contact them is by email, but no one responds.

sites.name: Minehut
sites.notes: Look for and click on the "Delete" account button. You will receive a confirmation email containing a link where you will need to confirm the deletion.

sites.name: Minha Band
sites.notes: Once logged in, use the link above or click on your user and then "Editar Perfil". Scroll to the bottom to click "Excluir conta Band", reenter your password and confirm.

sites.name: Miniclip
sites.notes: Log in, click on "Delete Account" tab and then click "Delete Account".

sites.name: MinID
sites.notes: You need to "block" your MinID first by sending [a form](https://eid.difi.no/sites/eid/files/2021-03/sperring_av_minid_en_v_1.3.pdf). You'll need to submit [another form](https://eid.difi.no/sites/eid/files/2021-03/sletting_fra_kontaktregister_en_v_1.2.pdf) if you want your information to be deleted from the contact registry.

sites.name: Mint
sites.notes: Go to 'Settings', then 'Sign In & Security', then scroll down to 'Delete your Mint account'. Enter your email and password again and click 'Delete'.

sites.name: mintos.com
sites.notes: Before requesting account deletion, make sure you wait for the remaining payments to come through, and withdraw all available funds. The account balance must be 0. Then you can either use a [request form](https://help.mintos.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=1900000292453) or send an email to support directly.

sites.name: Minute Cryptic
sites.notes: Click 'delete' and then type 'delete' to confirm.

sites.name: Miro
sites.notes: Click "Delete my profile" in the profile settings page. An e-mail with a verification code is sent to you, with which you can deactivate the account.

sites.name: MisterWong
sites.notes: You need to send an email to support and it may take up to 48 hours to process your request.

sites.name: Mistral AI
sites.notes: Click on the link, scroll down, and then click the 'Delete Account' button. If you have a paid subscription, you must cancel it first.

sites.name: MixCloud
sites.notes: Click on "Just delete my account".

sites.name: Mixlr
sites.notes: Login to your account, go to account section of the settings page and choose the "delete account" option.

sites.name: Mobalytics
sites.notes: Scroll to the bottom and click "Delete my account".

sites.name: Mobify
sites.notes: You have to send a message in order to remove your account.

sites.name: Mobileread Forums
sites.notes: It is possible to contact the webmaster, but there is no guarantee they will answer.

sites.name: Mobills
sites.notes: Just click the delete button. Note that if you have made an account via Google or Facebook, you'll have to change the password first.

sites.name: Mockflow
sites.notes: Login to your account ⮕ Open the menu and choose My Account ⮕ In the Profile Details tab click on 'Delete Account' & confirm deletion by entering your password.

sites.name: Modrinth
sites.notes: Go to the profile icon in the top right corner and select "Settings", then "Account", click "Delete account" at the bottom of the page, type your username and confirm. Your projects will not be deleted.

sites.name: Moises.ai
sites.notes: Download the Moises.ai app onto your smartphone and log into your account. Then visit "Profile", click the Settings cog in the top right corner, and click "Account info". You must give a reason on why you're deleting your account. If you don't have a subscription you can tick the checkbox to proceed with account deletion, which requires your password. Otherwise, you'll need to cancel your subscription. Finally, the account will be deleted.

sites.name: Mojang
sites.notes: If you have registered a Mojang account and would like to delete your account, please visit your account settings page. Please be aware that if your account is deleted, you will no longer be able to log into Mojang services, and will not be able to purchase future Mojang games.

sites.name: Molotov
sites.notes: Log in, go to your profile settings, finally find at the bottom of the page (Delete my account).

sites.name: Momox
sites.notes: You have to request account deletion through the contact form provided on their website.

sites.name: Momox Fashion
sites.notes: To get your account deleted, you have to contact their support via e-mail.

sites.name: Mon Compte Formation
sites.notes: On the "My Account" page, click on "Unregister"

sites.name: Mon Espace Santé
sites.notes: Login to your account, click on your profile, then on "Paramètres". Then click on "Clôture du profil"

sites.name: Mon Espace STAS
sites.notes: On your profile settings, scroll down and click on "Delete my account", then confirm by clicking on "Delete my subscription".

sites.name: Mon Petit Prono (MPP)
sites.notes: On your profile settings, scroll down and click on "Delete my account", then confirm by clicking on "Delete my account".

sites.name: Monarch Money
sites.notes: Click Delete Household in the Billing section of the Settings page.

sites.name: monday.com
sites.notes: Close all active product subscriptions in the Billing section of the Administration page, then click "Close my account".

sites.name: Money Dashboard
sites.notes: If you wish to delete your account and its belonging data and bank accounts held within it, you have to submit a request to the user support (or send an e-mail to support@moneydashboard.com). Make it clear that you require the full deletion of your account, not simply the deletion of one of your bank accounts. If you only want to delete/remove a bank account, but keep your Money Dashboard account open, please visit [https://help.moneydashboard.com/entries/21936798](https://help.moneydashboard.com/entries/21936798)

sites.name: Money Lover
sites.notes: Go to the menu on the top left corner, click 'My Account' then 'Delete Account' on the bottom of the dialog and confirm.

sites.name: Money Saving Expert
sites.notes: Just login to your account, select 'My Account', scroll to the bottom, select 'Settings' and click 'Close Account'

sites.name: MongoDB Atlas
sites.notes: To delete your MongoDB account you first need to delete all active clusters, projects and organizations linked with your account. Then click your name in the top right corner, click "Manage your MongoDB Account", and click "Profile Info" in the left panel. Click "Delete Account" and proceed with the presented steps.

sites.name: Monkeytype
sites.notes: Click the 'delete account' button.

sites.name: Monnaie de Paris
sites.notes: Contact support via email and request your account to be deleted.

sites.name: Monster
sites.notes: On the linked page, complete the form and ask for your account to be deleted.

sites.name: MonTCL
sites.notes: Go to your account settings, select "My personal data" and click on "Confirm the deletion of my monTCL account". You can also ask for deletion of all data related to you by clicking on "Request deletion of all my personal data"

sites.name: Moodle
sites.notes: After you place a request, you need to wait until the account is manually deleted by the administrator.

sites.name: Moonpig
sites.notes: Contact customer services and they'll respond in 24-48 hours. Not to mention the ways they try to hide you removing your card details. If you want to remove your card details, do the following: The easiest way to do this would be to go to the My Account page then click on the ‘Add Moonpig Prepay Credit’ link, click on the Buy link and your saved card details will be shown onscreen. Click on the ‘Remove Card’ option.

sites.name: Moovit
sites.notes: In the app, go to "Help & Support", then "My Accounts and Personal Information", "Deleting my Accounts and Personal Information", scroll to the bottom of the page and click "Give us feedback", and fill out the form requesting cancellation of the account. For "Feedback Type" choose "Edit or delete personal information", under "Privacy and Security". If you also want to delete the Moovit Editor account you will have to explicitly ask for it.

sites.name: Morningstar
sites.notes: Fill out the feedback form, asking them to delete your account. Be sure to specify that you’re not just unsubscribing from e-mail but that you want your account deleted entirely.

sites.name: Mote
sites.notes: Email them from the account you wish to delete.

sites.name: MouseCTRL
sites.notes: Email the support team from the email address of the account you wish to delete.

sites.name: Mouser
sites.notes: Visit the privacy policy page and scroll down to section Right to erasure (Right to have your data deleted). Enter your email address into the form. A link to the account deletion form will then be sent to your registered email address. To delete your account you have to fill out the form with details such as your full name and address. Once completed you will receive a confirmation email informing you that your account will be deleted within 30 days. Alternatively you can contact the data protection officer using the email address provided in the privacy policy.

sites.name: Mozilla Developer Network (MDN)
sites.notes:
Log in to Bugzilla and create a bug report to request the deletion of your account (see examples: [#1576401](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1576401)and [#1353345](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1353345)).

If you have made contributions to the MDN Web Docs, you will also need to specify what you would like to happen with them after deleting your account.

sites.name: Mozilla Support
sites.notes: On the Edit Profile page scroll down and click Close account and delete all profile information then type your username to confirm.

sites.name: MSI
sites.notes: On your account page, in Account section, go to Login Management, and in DELETE ACCOUNT click Delete.

sites.name: MTCGAME
sites.notes: There is no delete button nor do they ever reply by e-mail.

sites.name: Muambator
sites.notes: On your account page, scroll to the bottom and click on the red button to delete it.

sites.name: Mujirushi Ryōhin (Muji) / Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.
Mullvad
sites.notes: Contact support via email to request deletion of your account.

sites.name: MultCloud
sites.notes: Login to your account, click in the account icon ⮕ Settings ⮕ Delete Account and write the password and a note (optionally).

sites.name: Multiplayer Game Hacking MPGH
sites.notes: Accounts can not be deleted, but admins offer an 'account purge' per request. It is wise to manually strip your account from any personal data.

sites.name: MuniMobile (San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency)
sites.notes: If you mail them asking for deletion, you will get that "MuniMobile accounts cannot be deleted as we are required to retain the transaction information for financial audit purposes". They say they do deactivate the account, though.

sites.name: Munzee
sites.notes: Send an e-mail to privacy@freezetag.com. This email should include your first name, last name, e-mail address and, if applicable, your social network ID for the social network from which you access these services. (for example, your Facebook user ID)

sites.name: Musei Italiani
sites.notes: Send them an e-mail to request deletion.

sites.name: Musescore
sites.notes: Click on 'Delete account' at the left of the page.

sites.name: Musicboard
sites.notes: Navigate to Settings ⮕ preferences ⮕ Delete account (at the bottom of the page).

sites.name: MusicBrainz
sites.notes: Click on the 'Delete account' tab, then confirm with the 'Delete my account' button

sites.name: Musixmatch
sites.notes: Click the "Delete account" button. Your contributions will remain visible on our platform, but your name will no longer be displayed. It will take 7 days to process your account deletion request.

sites.name: Mutant Mail
sites.notes: Re-verify intent with your password at the bottom of the settings page and click 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: MXstore
sites.notes: Contact support using the linked form or by email and request account deletion.

sites.name: My Calendar
sites.notes: Contact support using the linked form or by email and request account deletion.

sites.name: My Fitness Pal
sites.notes: Just login and head to the account settings to click on delete account.

sites.name: My Invisalign
sites.notes: Login and select 'Delete Account' in the sidebar in your account settings

sites.name: My Lands
sites.notes: Contact the customer support via email and ask to delete your account. You should use the email of the country where you are registered: it's in the contacts, at the bottom of the website.

sites.name: MyAnimeList
sites.notes:
Enter your email address in the "Enter your registered email address" field and click "Confirmation" to request the deletion of your account. After that, confirm your request by clicking on the confirmation link that will be sent to you by email.

If your account has been banned for any reason or you are an MAL Supporter, request the deletion of your account through [this](https://myanimelist.net/about.php?go=contact) contact form instead of using the method explained above.

sites.name: MyBib
sites.notes: Select the account icon in the top left of the window, open Settings, select Account, then select Delete Account

sites.name: MyCreds
sites.notes: Account deletion has to be done by the issuing institution. Use the linked page to find the appropriate information for contacting the issuing institution.

sites.name: MyDisney
sites.notes: Deletable through account management. This will not delete your Disney+ account, see the relevant entry for it.

sites.name: myESET
sites.notes: At the bottom of the account page there is a Delete account button

sites.name: MyFigureCollection
sites.notes: At the bottom of the account settings page, click on "Delete my account"

sites.name: MyFonts
sites.notes: At the bottom of the linked page select 'Delete your MyFonts account' and confirm your password.

sites.name: MyFRITZ!
sites.notes: Login and select 'Delete Account' in the sidebar in your account settings

sites.name: Myfxbook
sites.notes: Account deletion can be achieved from within the profile settings.

sites.name: MyHeritage
sites.notes: Go to 'Account Settings' and then click 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: MyJDownloader
sites.notes: Go to your account settings (top right, click on your E-Mail-Address) and select 'Delete Account'

sites.name: MyMaxon
sites.notes: Visit the linked page, enter your password, and confirm you wish to delete your account.

sites.name: MyParcel
sites.notes: You have to create a support case to delete your account

sites.name: MyPlate
sites.notes: Send a request to the customer service team, including your account username or email address.

sites.name: MyScript
sites.notes: Accessing the URL triggers a confirmation mail containing a deletion link. Click this link and your account will be deleted immediately.

sites.name: Myworkdayjobs.com
sites.notes: Myworkdayjobs.com is an HR service provided by [Workday](https://www.workday.com/). Account deletion settings are determined by the company. It should be easy to find under User Settings; if not, try contacting the privacy team at the company you applied to.

sites.name: myWorld
sites.notes: Send an email requesting account deletion.

sites.name: Más Renfe
sites.notes: You need to send an email to delete your account.

sites.name: Méliuz
sites.notes: No self-service deletion is available. Call 0800 301 0101 and select the cancellation option.

sites.name: Namecheap
sites.notes: You have to contact Customer Support to delete your account, and provide your account username, support PIN, and reason why you would like to close your account. Customers with suspended accounts must first have them reinstated (by providing full government ID) before they can be deleted. Customers who reside in sanctioned countries (such as Russia) cannot delete their accounts at all until they provide proof of residency in a non-sanctioned country.

sites.name: NameMC
sites.notes: All of your followers, favorite servers, and social media information will be removed from all of your linked Minecraft profiles if you delete your NameMC account.

sites.name: Nandos
sites.notes: Contact Customer support to delete your account, referencing GDPR in the subject or body. After 14 days, your account will be deleted permanently.

sites.name: NaNoWriMo
sites.notes: At the bottom of the Account Settings page is a "Delete My Account" button. Your account will be "disabled and scheduled for permanent deletion." After 30 days, "your past novels, author profile, and unique account info will be permanently deleted." It is unclear if forum posts will be deleted.

sites.name: Napkin.ai
sites.notes: Click on your account in the top right, then 'Account settings', then 'Profile', then 'Delete account' and confirm the dialog to send a confirmation e-mail. In the e-mail, open the link and confirm the dialog.

sites.name: Napster
sites.notes: Start a chat and ask for your account to be deleted. You can delete anyone's account like this! Just "I'd like my account to be deleted." -"What email?" -"email@email.email" -"Ok, I have gone ahead and deleted it."

sites.name: National Express
sites.notes: No on-site way to delete an account, also does not reply to emails sent to email in the privacy policy for the data controller.

sites.name: NationStates
sites.notes: Stay logged out of your nation for 28 or 60 days, depending on your settings. However, your nation will be merely deactivated. The only way to have your nation truly deleted is to not have the nation long enough to reach a population of over 1 billion, and for someone else to create a nation with the same name at least 5 years after it was deactivated.

sites.name: Native
sites.notes: Fill out the contact form. They will email you to verify your request via email, and will then ask for two pieces of personal information from the account. They will then delete the account but retain information relevant to any orders made.

sites.name: Native Instruments
sites.notes: Fill the ticket form and wait for response.

sites.name: Natively
sites.notes: The privacy policy asks you to send them a message requesting account deletion and they'll do it for you.

sites.name: Natural Readers
sites.notes: Login first, then on the left menu click 'account' then 'edit' under your email address. A popup will appear where you can delete your account.

sites.name: Naukri
sites.notes: Log in ⮕ click on your profile picture ⮕ Click Settings ⮕ Communication and Privacy tab ⮕ Inside 'manage account' at the bottom, click on delete. Just enter your password to confirm. You may receive emails even after deletion and sometimes account deletion may not be possible due to internal errors. Ensure to have a password linked with your account.

sites.name: NAVER
sites.notes: Re-registration is not possible with a deleted ID, and posts written on the bulletin board are not automatically deleted. So, make delete or make them private before you terminate your account.

sites.name: Navigraph
sites.notes: Log in if needed, confirm your e-mail address, and click on 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: NCBI
sites.notes: Accounts will be deleted after 2 years of inactivity

sites.name: Nearpod
sites.notes: Requires to fill out contact form. Will still get Promotional emails until you also unsubscribe from them

sites.name: Nebula
sites.notes: If you have an active subscription, cancel it first, then confirm the deletion on the account deletion page.

sites.name: Neocities.org
sites.notes: You'll be prompted to give a reason on why you're deleting your site, as well as typing in the name of your website to delete it.

sites.name: NeoDB
sites.notes: Click on 'Delete account' near the bottom of the page and follow the instructions.

sites.name: Neon Pagamentos
sites.notes: Neon accounts cannot be deleted, only canceled.

sites.name: Neopets
sites.notes: Send an email to the support@neopets.com stating you wish to delete your account.

sites.name: Netbela Hosting
sites.notes: Create a ticket to the Billing department and request your account to be deleted.

sites.name: NetBird
sites.notes: Go to the "Settings" tab, then click on "Danger Zone". Review the message and click on the "Delete Account" button.

sites.name: Netdata
sites.notes: In your profile preferences, click 'Delete account' then confirm.

sites.name: Netflix
sites.notes: To delete your account, cancel your active membership, click on the provided link, and scroll down to the 'Delete Account' button. Enter the confirmation code, and your account will be deleted automatically on the day your subscription ends. Accounts without a membership will be deleted automatically after 10 months.

sites.name: Netgate
sites.notes: You need to send an email. If you have placed any orders (even for $0) in the last 7 years, support will refuse to delete your account.

sites.name: Netlify
sites.notes: Press the 'delete' button and then enter your name to confirm.

sites.name: Netology
sites.notes: It is not possible to delete your account.  The best you can do is delete any personal information that you have stored on their website.

sites.name: Netus AI
sites.notes: Log in to Netus AI and open the profile page via the URL or by clicking the avatar icon near the top right corner. Click on 'Delete Account'. You will be prompted to verify the request via an OTP sent to your email. After entering the correct OTP, click 'Delete Permanently' to permanently remove your account.

sites.name: New Relic
sites.notes: From the New Relic menu bar, select (account) ⮕ Upgrade subscription ⮕ Cancel account. Select the confirmation prompt.

sites.name: New York Times
sites.notes: Use the form to request deletion of all of your personal data, they will only do it if law mandates like GDPR (Europe), otherwise account will just be deactivated. You might be required to confirm the request by mail or another form of contact.

sites.name: Newegg
sites.notes: Visit the linked page, select 'Delete my personal information', write your first name, last name, email and request, for example: 'Please delete my account and all personal information you have about me', click 'Submit'. You'll receive a confirmation email, click 'Verify Your Email'. Your request will be completed in few days (usually 2 business days).

sites.name: Newgrounds
sites.notes: Go to your account settings and select "Request Account Deletion." It can take up to 30 days for your account to be completely deleted.

sites.name: Newspapers.com
sites.notes: Click the link to send a message to support and ask them to delete your account.

sites.name: Newspipe
sites.notes: There is a  "delete your account" button, but it was not working. Mailing them does.

sites.name: Nexo
sites.notes: Login to your account, go to 'Account ⮕ Security' and enable 2FA. Go to the URL and then close your account.

sites.name: Nexon
sites.notes: Submit a ticket requesting account deletion.

sites.name: Nextbike Germany
sites.notes: Send an e-mail via the link below. After sending your account deletion request, you might never receive an answer, just check back a few days later if you still have access to the account.

sites.name: NextDNS
sites.notes: Navigate to account settings and click the delete account button.

sites.name: Nextdoor
sites.notes: Accounts can only be deleted by contacting their support team.

sites.name: Ngan Luong
sites.notes:
Enter your current password and click "Continue". Notification: After requesting to close the account, NganLuong will proceed to approve:
 - If the account is being disputed, Ngan Luong will ask you to resolve the dispute before closing the account.
 - If the account still has a balance, Ngan Luong will guide you to pay off the balance before closing.
 Accounts cannot be reopened once closed, you should consider before closing.

sites.name: ngrok
sites.notes: Enter your email and click "Delete". You will get a popup, where you must click "Delete User"

sites.name: NicePage
sites.notes: Deletion requires submitting a forum post in the Contact page and waiting on a representative to email you back to confirm the deletion

sites.name: Niche
sites.notes: Deactivating your account in account settings does not fully remove your data. To delete your data, you need to file a deletion request at the linked page.

sites.name: Nike
sites.notes: Click on your name on the right top of the screen, then click in 'Minha Conta', on field 'Meu Cadastro' click in 'Alterar dados pessoais', select 'Editar', on the bottom of the page, click on 'Excluir Conta'.

sites.name: Nike+
sites.notes: At the bottom of the account form, there is a 'Deactivate Account' button. Upon clicking, there will be a set of information that explains the process of account deactivation. All account information will be deleted.

sites.name: Ninox
sites.notes: Contact Support via the online contact form and request your account to be deleted. Alternatively you can use the support E-Mail address.

sites.name: Nintendo
sites.notes: Scroll down and press deactivate and delete, it will be deactived for 30 days and then permanently deleted, if a Nintendo Network ID is linked to the account, it will not be deleted in this process

sites.name: Nitrous Networks
sites.notes: You need to login in order to request the removal.

sites.name: nixware
sites.notes: There’s no such option, at least not at the moment. (answer from moderator)

sites.name: Njalla
sites.notes: Type your password and confirm your action by clicking "Delete Account".

sites.name: NodeChef
sites.notes: In the dashboard, go to the "Account" tab, scroll down to "Delete Account" section, follow the instructions and then click "Delete my account".

sites.name: NoIP
sites.notes: At the bottom of the linked page, click the 'Delete Account' button. Check the 'I understand' box, then click 'Confirm'.

sites.name: Nomad
sites.notes: You have to clear the account before requesting the account deletion on the app. And after 15 or 20 days of email confirmation, the account is finally deleted.

sites.name: NordPass
sites.notes: "If you’d like to delete your account or data, please contact us at support@nordpass.com"

sites.name: NordVPN
sites.notes: Login, then go to your account settings page. There is a delete account button. It makes you verify your email with a 6 digit code, then allows deletion.

sites.name: Norton
sites.notes: You must cancel all active subscriptions before deleting your account. They will send a code to your email address to verify your identity.

sites.name: NoteJoy
sites.notes: Open account settings ⮕ Account ⮕ Cancel Account. Write down a reason and click "Cancel"

sites.name: Notesnook
sites.notes: Log in to your account via the app or website, go to the settings, click on "Profile" and then "Delete account".

sites.name: Notion
sites.notes: Go to "Settings & members", then "My account", and click "Delete my account", type your email address and confirm.

sites.name: Novation Music
sites.notes: 'Users have the right, under certain circumstances, to obtain the erasure of their Data from the Owner.'

sites.name: NovelAI
sites.notes: Log into your account, and press your account icon in the top left corner of the screen. Under the User Settings column, select 'Account'. Next to 'Delete Account', click the 'Request' button. Submit your email address, then check your inbox for an account deletion confirmation. Follow the included link, then click 'Delete Account'. Your data will be deleted within 24 hours.

sites.name: NovoEd
sites.notes: Create a new request titled "Please delete my account" using your e-mail address and the topic "Course Not Listed/Not Course Related".

sites.name: NOW TV
sites.notes: You must first cancel any active passes under 'My Account' ⮕ 'My Passes'. After this, you can contact the live chat and ask for your billing information to be removed. Your account must remain inactive for an indeterminate amount of time before the remaining data will be removed 'in accordance with our group data retention and deletion policies'.

sites.name: npm
sites.notes: Go to your account settings and press 'Delete your account'.

sites.name: NS (Nederlandse Spoorwegen)
sites.notes: Login to your NS (Nederlandse Spoorwegen) account and click on the linked URL. On this page you can click "Delete NS-account" in order to delete your account.

sites.name: NS1
sites.notes: Email support and request account deletion. They will process your request and email you when it has been deleted.

sites.name: nTask
sites.notes: To delete your nTask account, follow this simple procedure: Using your registered email for nTask, send a request titled "Account Deletion" to "support@ntaskmanager.com" mentioning your name and email address. Once the request is received, it will take 24 hours to process your request

sites.name: Nubank
sites.notes: Nubank accounts cannot be deleted, only canceled.

sites.name: Nube
sites.notes: According to the privacy policy, accounts cannot be deleted, only deactivated (and reactivated later).

sites.name: Nulled
sites.notes: They DO NOT delete accounts, just log out.

sites.name: Numista
sites.notes: The text box can be left blank. Simply click "Definitely unsubscribe" - this will permanently remove all your data.

sites.name: Numworks
sites.notes: Account deletion requires contacting Customer Support. They may ask you your ID card but you can decline quoting [article 5 c from GDPR](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-5-gdpr/)(data minimisation)

sites.name: Nutaku
sites.notes: Click the Delete Account Button

sites.name: NVIDIA
sites.notes: Open the link, sign in, click 'Delete my data', click the confirmation link sent to your email, type in DELETE and press ok.

sites.name: O'Reilly
sites.notes: The only way to delete an account is to send an e-mail to privacy mail as instructed on their privacy policy section 6.2 (https://www.oreilly.com/privacy.html).

sites.name: Obi
sites.notes: To delete your account, simply log in to your Obi.de account, click on the provided link, and delete your account with the button on the bottom of the page.

sites.name: Obsidian
sites.notes: Go to the linked page, scroll down, click the red 'Delete' button next to 'Delete account' and confirm.

sites.name: OceanHero
sites.notes: You need to [open a support ticket](https://oceanhero.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

sites.name: Octopus
sites.notes: Hit the button with the user icon in the top-right. Navigate to the 'Settings' tab and pick 'Delete my account'.

sites.name: Oculus / Meta VR
sites.notes: Visit the linked page then go to the 'Delete your Meta and Horizon data' section, from there you will be able to choose to delete your account.

sites.name: Odeon
sites.notes: You must submit a request to support. Live chat also works. The process takes 30 days to complete.

sites.name: Odnoklassniki
sites.notes: Login to your account, scroll License Agreement down, click Delete profile, check any boxes you want, enter password and press Remove button.

sites.name: OfferUp
sites.notes: Login to your account, click Delete Account, provide reason for deletion, confirm and complete. Very simple.

sites.name: Office Depot México
sites.notes: There is no visible way to delete an account in their website. Additionally, after contacting Support in the linked e-Mail, a response is yet to be received.

sites.name: OfficeDepot
sites.notes: Note that while their privacy policy states that California residents may have their information deleted permanently, it does not specify whether they delete other accounts also. Go to the URL and fill out the form with the information pertaining to your account. Open the 'Delete My Information' section and check the box next to 'Delete my consumer data'. Submit the form and wait for an email to arrive. Click the link in the email. If after 24 hours your account is not deleted, you might have to reach out to their customer support and present their Privacy Policy to have them act.

sites.name: OGLoot
sites.notes: Need to write a ticket for the app. Once the account is deleted, it is impossible to create a new account with the same login information.

sites.name: OK
sites.notes: Visit the linked page and click the "Delete profile" button at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: OkCupid
sites.notes: Visit your settings page, and select 'Delete Account'

sites.name: Olo
sites.notes: Click the link in the email sent to you

sites.name: OLX
sites.notes: Click in the profile link, privacy and security and at the very bottom of the page, click in the Delete Account link and enter the password.

sites.name: Olympics
sites.notes: In the bottom of the page, click 'Stop using Posti’s electronic services'.

sites.name: OM Personal English
sites.notes: Go to the bottom of the linked page, and under "Delete account", click on the red button with the same name.

sites.name: OmaPosti
sites.notes: In the bottom of the page, click 'Stop using Posti’s electronic services'.

sites.name: omegaUp
sites.notes: Go to the linked page and click on the "Delete" button, then confirm in the pop-up window by clicking on "Delete" again. All personal information is immediately deleted. If the account does not get deleted, write an e-Mail to support asking for help. You might need to manually log out once the deletion occurs.

sites.name: Omnipilot
sites.notes: On your account page, click on 'Delete Account' then confirm.

sites.name: Ondéa Grand Lac
sites.notes: On your profile page, scroll down, click on "Supprimer mon compte" then click on "Oui, supprimer".

sites.name: One Month
sites.notes: Email support@honeybadger.io asking to close your account.

sites.name: OneCompiler
sites.notes: Click your profile image in the top right corner of the page and open 'My account'. Select the 'Settings' tab, then click 'Account', and press the 'Delete My Account' button. Submit the code sent your email.

sites.name: OneFootball
sites.notes: You need to contact OneFootball support by e-mail.

sites.name: OnePlus
sites.notes: In your account details, there is an option to request account deletion. According to OnePlus, the request will be reviewed within 10 days, but if you sign in during this period the request will be withdrawn.

sites.name: OnePrep
sites.notes: Go into settings and click on the 'Delete Account' button.

sites.name: OneSky
sites.notes: Contact Support.

sites.name: Onet
sites.notes: You just need to click 'Delete account', then enter your account password and tick the checkbox

sites.name: Online Judge (formerly UVa Online Judge)
sites.notes: There is no option to delete an existing account. You may try requesting the deletion at the linked page, by filling out their contact form, but keep in mind they might never reach out.

sites.name: Online.net
sites.notes: The french law forces them to keep your account because it's linked to your bills.

sites.name: OnlineTVRecorder.com
sites.notes: You can deactivate your account with the link. But the data isn't deleted. Even if you contact the support they don't delete your data.

sites.name: OnlyFans
sites.notes: On settings tab, select the option 'Delete Account' and enter the captcha. After that, you'll receive an e-mail with the confirmation.

sites.name: Onshape
sites.notes: Go to your account page, click the "Delete my Onshape account" link, enter your password and confirm your choice. Existing links to and copies of your documents will still remain active.

sites.name: OnThatAss
sites.notes: Subscriptions renew before you've received your last pair. To delete your data you must not have an active subscription. They will not help you at all and will not refund payments made without your knowledge. Even after your last payment and after receiving the item, you'll still need to wait. Clicking delete is merely a request and you'll have to wait for them to accept the request.

sites.name: Open Collective
sites.notes: Navigate from the Dashboard to 'Settings' ⮕ 'Advanced' ⮕ 'Delete this account'.

sites.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT
sites.notes: Follow the link and click "Delete".

sites.name: OpenCores
sites.notes: They recommend e-mailing to request for deletion, but the e-mail is never answered.

sites.name: Opendesktop
sites.notes: E-mail their support to get the account deleted.

sites.name: OpenDNS
sites.notes: You can delete the account by visiting the delete account page.

sites.name: OpenFoodFacts
sites.notes: Go to the bottom of the page and click Delete user

sites.name: OpenGuessr
sites.notes: Log in, click on your username at the top of the page, select 'Delete Account' under 'Account Management'.

sites.name: OpenInvest
sites.notes: Email them telling them you want to delete your account. They will retain some information as necessary to "comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce our agreements" (from their TOS and Privacy Policy), but most data will be deleted within 30 days.

sites.name: OpenPhone
sites.notes: You need to contact OpenPhone support.

sites.name: OpenRouter
sites.notes: Next to user click manage, go to the security tab, click delete account and type delete account in the box.

sites.name: OpenSea
sites.notes: Deleting your account is only possible if an applicable government policy gives you the right to delete your account.

sites.name: OpenStreetMap
sites.notes: Log In, go to the linked page and confirm the deletion

sites.name: OpenSubtitles.com
sites.notes: Click 'Delete Account' and enter your password.

sites.name: OpenTable
sites.notes: If you are using the iOS app, you can delete your account via Account Settings ⮕ Your details ⮕ Delete my account. Otherwise, you will need to contact OpenTable on their help page or via email

sites.name: OpenWeather
sites.notes: Main website may still show you logged in after deletion (compared to the account management site). In that case, cookies need to cleared.

sites.name: Opera
sites.notes: On the linked page select 'Delete my account'.

sites.name: Optum
sites.notes: On the linked page select "Deactivate Account" and provide the code sent to the account's email address.

sites.name: Oracle
sites.notes: You have to send a privacy inquiry to get your data deleted. (It can take a few days)

sites.name: ORCID
sites.notes: Visit the linked page and click "Deactivate you ORCID account". Deactivation deletes identifiable information associated with the ID and cryptographically hashes your email address to ensure reactivation of the ID only being possible from your email.

sites.name: OSBuddy
sites.notes: You must contact support via your account's registered email address to request deletion.

sites.name: Osu!
sites.notes: You can only request account deletion by sending an email.

sites.name: otter.ai
sites.notes: Account deletion can be achieved from within the account settings. Simply go to 'Account settings' and press 'Delete account'. Then confirm by entering your password.

sites.name: Otto.de
sites.notes: On your profile page, scroll down to 'Konto verwalten' and select 'Meine persönlichen Daten und Kundenkonto löschen.' Once you confirm the deletion in the dialog box, your request will undergo a manual review, which may take several days. After the review process is complete, your account will be successfully deleted.

sites.name: Outdooractive
sites.notes: Follow the instructions provided to navigate to your profile and find the delete account button.

sites.name: Outsideinc
sites.notes: On Outside Inc., the deletion procedure differs depending on the medium. On the web, there is no direct button: you must submit a deletion form specific to your country. Although the option is available on mobile devices, it is recommended that you use the web form to ensure compliance with legal deadlines (up to 30 days depending on jurisdiction). Important: Before taking any action, you must cancel your subscription to stop payments. Please note that this action is global and will permanently delete your Gaia GPS, Trailforks, athleteReg, and Outside accounts.

sites.name: OV-chipkaart
sites.notes: You have the right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') with ov-chipkaart.nl, only you have to send an email and exercise your right to erasure to do so. Send an email to the email address provided requesting to delete your account and personal information.

sites.name: Overleaf
sites.notes: Select 'Delete your account' at the bottom of the account settings page.

sites.name: Overstock
sites.notes: You must contact support directly and ask them to invalidate your account.  However, your transaction data may not be deleted from their records.

sites.name: overtake

sites.notes: Yes and no, it depends on which type(s) of accounts, and you will need to delete the accounts in the correct order. Everything else, such as Launchpad.net, cloud file storage, AskUbuntu, and other accounts should be closed first if possible. sites.notes:
To request that your Chalk account be deleted, open the Chalk app and navigate to Settings ⮕ My Account, and tap Delete Account. When a pop-up appears at the bottom of your screen, tap Request account deletion. This action will trigger a process in which a PTC Administrator will delete the specific personal or business user. If the user account being deleted belongs to a Primary Administrator, a new Primary Administrator must be designated before the user account can be deleted. Business Account users may need to contact their company administrator. You can contact your administrator by navigating to Settings ⮕ Help ⮕ Contact Company Admin in the Chalk app.
Alternatively you might still be able to reach the Vuforia team at PTC by [email](mailto:vuforia-support@ptc.com) (vuforia-support@ptc.com) or get transferred by calling your regions phone number found [here]( https://support.ptc.com/company/mathsoft/).

sites.notes: Profile can be deleted from iOS app according to the help article. Otherwise, the [Privacy Policy](https://wheniwork.com/privacy) states you may request to delete account information by contacting support.

sites.name: Where Am I?
sites.notes: Log in to the mobile app, click on your username at the bottom navigation, select 'Delete Account' under 'Account Management'.

sites.name: Which?
sites.notes: Require your membership number to be sent in the email. This can be found [here](https://www.which.co.uk/account/#/)

sites.name: Whimsical
sites.notes: You will need to enter your e-mail address and then confirm by re-authenticating.

sites.name: Whirlpool
sites.notes: Whirlpool refuses to permanently delete accounts and instead suggests that the best solution is 'simply to exercise self control and not log in anymore'. In exceptional circumstances (e.g. death, legal threats, security risks) you may contact a moderator to request that your account be marked as inactive or placed in the penalty box. The site also refuses to delete a large amount of posts on your behalf, so the best solution may be to turn on 2FA, change your username/email address to something that's not used elsewhere and not login anymore.

sites.name: Whitepages
sites.notes: You must call customer service to have your account deleted. The most up-to-date phone number can be found at the bottom of the linked page, then dial 1 and 2 when prompted. You only need to provide your email address.

sites.name: Whizlabs
sites.notes: Submit a request to delete your account using the contact form provided.

sites.name: Whoisfreaks
sites.notes: You can delete your own account by navigating to the Profile and then clicking on the `delete account` button.

sites.name: WhoSampled
sites.notes: Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the "Delete My Account" button.

sites.name: WhoSay.com
sites.notes: Just click 'Deactivate'.

sites.name: Wifi Map
sites.notes: Follow the link, log in, choose a reason (optional), then click on Delete account.

sites.name: WiGLE
sites.notes: Go to the linked page and follow the instructions.

sites.name: Wikidot
sites.notes: Click on 'Delete account'. Confirm account deletion through the link sent to user email address.

sites.name: wikiHow
sites.notes: Requires emailing them to request for deletion.

sites.name: Wikimedia Commons
sites.notes: An account cannot be deleted as all contibutions to Wikimedia Commons are licensed under licenses that require attribution. However, you can place the template {{SD|U1}} on your user and talk pages, and rename your account to something random [here](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:GlobalRenameRequest)

sites.name: Wikipedia
sites.notes: An account cannot be deleted because to all contributions to Wikipedia are licensed under licenses that require attribution. However, they do have some suggestions, such as [Courtesy Vanishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Courtesy_vanishing)

sites.name: Wilds.io
sites.notes: Go to 'Settings and controls', then scroll to 'Delete my account'.

sites.name: Wilson epark
sites.notes: Send your request for account deletion to epark either via the form on the 'Contact Us' page, or by sending them an email.

sites.name: Wilson Parking
sites.notes: To delete your online prepaid account, download the Wilson Parking App, select 'Account', 'Your Profile' under the 'About You' header, then scroll to 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: Windscribe
sites.notes: Visit the linked page, enter your password, give a cancellation reason and click "Delete Account" at the bottom.

sites.name: Windsurf
sites.notes: Follow the linked URL, log in if needed, and click on the "Delete account" button to proceed with deletion.

sites.name: Windy
sites.notes: Go to the linked page, enter your email and password, click on 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: Wine HQ
sites.notes: Send an E-Mail to the webmaster. If that didn't work, create a new forum thread on https://forum.winehq.org

sites.name: Wire
sites.notes: On Windows/MacOS : Go Settings ⮕ Account ⮕ Delete Account And on mobile devices Tap Profile ⮕ Settings ⮕ Account ⮕ Delete Account. You will receive a SMS to confirm the deletion.

sites.name: Wise
sites.notes: You can find the "Close Account" option at the bottom of the settings page, but you can log in any time after closing to reactivate it, so it is never deleted.

sites.name: WiseMapping
sites.notes: Click on the profile icon in the top right corner and select "Account", then check the box next to "Delete Account" and click on "Accept".

sites.name: Wish
sites.notes: You will have to edit your 'Country' in the profile to be a country covered by e.g. GDPR (for example, France). Otherwise, you will not see the 'Permanently delete account' option when you click on 'Manage Account' (you will only see 'Deactivate account').

sites.name: WishSimply
sites.notes: Enter your account password and click on 'DELETE ACCOUNT'.

sites.name: Withings
sites.notes: You can delete your account after logging in, in one click from the user settings page. You can also choose to have your data sent to you first. The deletion process takes 7 days.

sites.name: Wix
sites.notes: Make sure you're logged in and fill the form to delete the account.

sites.name: Wizarding World
sites.notes: Does not delete data from a previous Pottermore account. See [Pottermore entry](https://justdeleteme.xyz/#pottermore).

sites.name: Wizards of the Coast
sites.notes: Fill up the form requesting deletion. The customer support will reach back asking for tens of information to confirm deletion in each service they have. Provide what you can/remember and it eventually gets deleted.

sites.name: WIZBII
sites.notes: Click on 'Delete my account'

sites.name: Wizz Air
sites.notes: Log in and click the 'Delete Account' button at the bottom of the compliments and complaints page.

sites.name: WolframAlpha.com
sites.notes: For the immediate future, send a message to WolframAlpha, and your Wolfram ID will be deleted manually.

sites.name: Woltlab
sites.notes: Your account will be deleted after a 7-day grace period. Created content, like forum posts, will not be deleted. Your username will be anonymized and protected against re-registration for a year.

sites.name: Wondershare
sites.notes: Log into your account, then visit the "Account" tab and go to Profile. There will be a "Delete Account" button in the top right that'll let you delete your account. You'll enter a 6 digit code sent to your email to proceed with account deletion. Wondershare will hold your account for a week before deleting it, but you can force it as there's a button on screen that lets you delete it immediately.

sites.name: Woolworths
sites.notes: Select the 'Chat with us' option and inform the chat bot you wish to delete your account until it gives you to option to talk to a human. Select that, tell them you want your account deleted, and they will action it for you.

sites.name: Woot
sites.notes: From the support page, choose 'I want to look at my account!' ⮕ 'I want to deactivate my account.' and you will then see a form where you can fill out your request.

sites.name: Wordfeud
sites.notes: Log in to your Wordfeud account in the Wordfeud app and go to settings. Click on 'Wordfeud-account' and click 'Delete account'. A notice will appear telling you your account is planned for deletion in 7 days.

sites.name: WordPress.com
sites.notes: First cancel any active subscriptions in your account. Then go to Account Settings, click 'Delete your account permanently', click 'Delete account', click 'Continue', enter your username and click 'Delete Account'. You will not be able to open a new account using this email for 30 days and your WooCommerce, Crowdsignal, IntenseDebate, and Gravatar accounts will also be deleted.

sites.name: WordPress.org
sites.notes: Use the linked form to request account deletion. This will prompt an automatic request for verification of email-address ownership. Once you verify ownership of the email-address, then the account is deleted. Forum activity will be anonymized rather than deleted.

sites.name: workupload
sites.notes: Write a short mail using their web contact form.

sites.name: Workwise.io
sites.notes: Click on the link, scroll down and click on 'Delete Account'. After confirmation your account will be deleted immediately.

sites.name: World Market
sites.notes: According to their help page, you must send an e-mail to them to request the deletion. The deletion is completed within 2-4 weeks.

sites.name: WorldAnvil
sites.notes: Visit the linked page, scroll down to `Account Deletion`, enter your username, then click `Delete Account`

sites.name: WOT (Web Of Trust)
sites.notes: Log into your account ⮕ go to "My profile" page ⮕ click on pencil icon ⮕ click on "Delete account".

sites.name: WP
sites.notes: Visit the linked page, click `Usuń konto`, log in again, then click `Usuń konto ze skrzynką`.

sites.name: WT.Social
sites.notes: Only deactivation is possible

sites.name: X
sites.notes: Your account is deactivated before being deleted. After 30 days of remaining deactivated it will then be deleted.

sites.name: XDA Developers
sites.notes: Visit this 'Data Deletion Request Form' and fill in the form. Make sure to specify if you want your posts deleted.

sites.name: XenForo Italia
sites.notes: Visit the linked page and delete your account. Your account will be deleted in 3 days.

sites.name: Xing
sites.notes: Select 'Delete Profile' at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: XREAL
sites.notes: "Account deactivation requires you to contact the support email, and they will assist you with the deactivation process. Deactivation removes all your personal information, including your account details, profile, and data associated with your account. This information will be permanently removed, and the operation cannot be undone."

sites.name: XSplit
sites.notes: At the bottom of the account settings there is a delete account button. You'll just need to re-enter your password.

sites.name: Yahoo!
sites.notes: Account gets deactivated for a waiting period of 30-180 days depending on your country, then permanently deleted.

sites.name: Yammer
sites.notes: On the above URL, click the 'Delete your Yammer account' link in the top right and confirm.

sites.name: Yandex
sites.notes: On the above URL, confirm the deletion by entering the CAPTCHA code. If backup email and/or phone added you will need to send a confirmation code and fill in the code(s). Press "Delete account" and confirm deletion in the dialog box.

sites.name: Yelp
sites.notes: Closing your account does not remove all data. To delete the data associated with your account, you must email them. Additional information can be found here: [Yelp - Support Center - How do I close my account?](https://www.biz.yelp.com/support-center/article/How-do-I-close-my-account).

sites.name: YeolPumTa
sites.notes: Locate the delete button within the app.

sites.name: Yoast
sites.notes: Click "Account" then click "Delete your account".

sites.name: youlookfab
sites.notes: Login ⮕ Profile Dropdown ⮕ Profile ⮕ Account ⮕ Delete Your Account

sites.name: YouNow
sites.notes: Press "Deactivate my account"

sites.name: YouSee.dk
sites.notes: Fill out the form and request account deletion. Verification of your identity is required via MitID. Processing of the request takes up to 30 days. Payment history is kept for 5 years.

sites.name: Yousician
sites.notes: Go to your account, scroll down and click "Delete account" in the "Advanced Settings" section. You will be prompted to enter your password.

sites.name: YouTrack
sites.notes: You cannot delete your account, but anonymize your data. In your Profile settings page, on the top-right corner there is an "anonymize user" button. Click it, then your name&username will be anonymized and e-mail will be removed.

sites.name: YouTube
sites.notes:
Click the trash can next to YouTube and confirm the verification email. You can request a copy of your data, before you delete it.
If you want to delete your entire Google account, use the instructions for [Google](https://justdeleteme.xyz/#google).

sites.name: YRIS
sites.notes: To unsubscribe from YRIS, open the application on your smartphone, log in, go to "Settings" (the icon at the bottom right of the main screen), then click on "Delete my account". If you are unable to log in, you can request to unsubscribe via the contact form.

sites.name: Yuka
sites.notes: After logging in the application, on your mobile device, visit the link and follow the instructions provided.

sites.name: Yummly
sites.notes: Select "To delete your account, click here" at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: YUR
sites.notes: Requests will be processed in accordance with local laws. Request account removal by sending an email to them or filling the form (requires Google account). Include your full name, email address associated with your account and a detailed description of your data request.

sites.name: Z-Library
sites.notes: Click on top-right-corner menu ⮕ Edit Profile ⮕ Remove Profile ⮕ Remove my account. Enter Captcha to remove account permanently. Note that you'll unable to create a new account associated with this emailID.

sites.name: Zalando
sites.notes: Click on the link, log in and then click on the "Delete your account" tab. Finally, click on "Request account and data deletion".

sites.name: Zamnesia
sites.notes: If you want to have your account deleted you have to send Zamnesia an email and they will delete your account according to the GDPR rules.

sites.name: Zanichelli
sites.notes: Go to your profile, click on the button to delete the account and confirm. Your account will be deleted after 30 days, if you log in during this period, you cancel the deletion of the account.

sites.name: Zap Imóveis
sites.notes: Access the link and click on 'Excluir Conta'

sites.name: Zapier
sites.notes: Go to the URL, confirm your email. You'll be redirected to the login page. Confirm your email again and enter "DELETE" (all caps) In the "Confirm you want to delete your account" field.

sites.name: Zappos
sites.notes: Contact chat support. You may be asked to verify your identity with your last name & billing address.

sites.name: Zave it
sites.notes: Go to your profile, then click on: Contact support ⮕ Create a support ticket ⮕ I want to delete my account ⮕ Delete account

sites.name: Zaxby's
sites.notes: Call 1-866-892-9297 and press 2 to be connected with a reward account services agent and ask to have your account deleted. Your account will be deleted after 24-48 hours.

sites.name: Zazzle
sites.notes: To terminate your account, simply send a message via their web contact form to Customer Care that contains your username and the email address associated with your account.  Once you've done so, a member of our Support Team will disable your account and remove any products, both public and private, and disable your store (if applicable).  The account will be deleted fully when our system processes the next batch of account removals.

sites.name: ZDNet
sites.notes: Needs an additional e-mail verification. Additionally, user can contact ZDNet for manual account deletion.

sites.name: Zeet
sites.notes: Click on the "Delete Account" button.

sites.name: Zeit Online
sites.notes: Send an Email with the Username

sites.name: Zello
sites.notes: Click on the "Delete Account" button.

sites.name: Zenamu
sites.notes: To request account deletion, you must email them

sites.name: Zendesk
sites.notes: Go to Admin⮕Settings⮕Subscription and click 'Yes, cancel my account'.

sites.name: Zenkit
sites.notes: Login to your account, go to profile, scroll down and click 'Delete Account'. Confirm by entering 'DELETEMYACCOUNT' and click 'Delete My Account'.

sites.name: ZenMarket
sites.notes: You must contact support to request account deletion.

sites.name: Zenni Optical
sites.notes: Open a support ticket or call them. Upon calling (800) 211-2105 and using the '1' extension to talk to a human customer service agent, explain that you want to delete your account. Provide your account email and confirm that you will no longer be able to use that email to create a future account. After confirming, it takes 24-48h to receive an account deletion confirmation email

sites.name: Zeplin
sites.notes: You need to transfer or delete your projects and cancel your subscription (if you have one) before deleting you account. Unlink your google account if you used it to login. Go to "Profile" ⮕ "account" ⮕ click "Want to remove your account completely?" ⮕ click "DELETE ACCOUNT" and provide your password.

sites.name: Zepp/Zepp Life
sites.notes: In the specified page, click "Delete account", and select the specific app where you have created the account, log in, press "Delete account" again, and then follow the instructions

sites.name: Zero
sites.notes: Open the app switch to the 'me' page and then My Data ⮕ Delete my account

sites.name: ZeroSSL
sites.notes: Scroll to the bottom of the linked page and click 'Delete Account'.

sites.name: ZeroTier
sites.notes: Go to your account page and click on the "delete account" button.

sites.name: ZombieLink
sites.notes: Scroll down to 'Delete and Reset Account' and click the red link: 'delete your account'

sites.name: Zoológico de São Paulo
sites.notes: They state it cannot be deleted.

sites.name: Zoom
sites.notes: Login to your account, go to 'Account Profile', click 'Terminate my account'. Enter password in dialog box and confirm.

sites.name: Zotero
sites.notes: Login to your account, go to 'Settings', click on 'Permanently Delete Account' at the bottom of the page.

sites.name: Zulip
sites.notes: Navigate to Settings ⮕ Your Account ⮕ Deactivate Account

sites.name: zyBooks
sites.notes: Submit a deletion request by emailing them or calling +1-833-719-2300.

sites.name: Zynga
sites.notes: Select the game you want to delete your account from (if you want to delete the entire account choose zyngagames.com). Log in. Click on the FAQ tab on the top navigation bar. Then click “Go here to request account deletion”. Click the box indicating your understanding and then click Continue. To confirm deletion, click the box, select a reason, and then click Delete My Account. Your account deletion request is now pending. Expect the deletion request to be completed within 30 days of the request.

sites.name: Zzo.ai
sites.notes: Log in, visit the profile page, scroll to the bottom and click the 'Delete Account' button. A warning dialog will appear, click 'Confirm' to delete your account.

sites.name: ÇiçekSepeti
sites.notes: In order to delete your account you have to email them and fill out their "KVKK" form and send them an email. [The form is only in Turkish](https://cdn03.ciceksepeti.com/images/Ciceksepeti_KVKK_Basvuru_Formu_06022019.docx).

sites.name: Île-de-France Mobilités Connect
sites.notes: Log in to the account Île-de-France Mobilités Connect that you want to deactivate, in the "My space" section, select "Manage my information", click on the link "Deactivate my Île-de-France Mobilités Connect account", click the "Confirm Deactivation" button

sites.name: ÖBB
sites.notes: You can easily delete your ÖBB customer account in the account settings page. Go to your account area at shop.oebbtickets.at or in the ÖBB app and go to the account settings. There you will find the menu item "Close account".

sites.name: РешуОГЭ/РешуЕГЭ/СдамГИА
sites.notes: Go to the linked page and click "Удалить учетную запись".
